model.title: Ensuring SBA Implementation of GAO Recommendations Act of 2026
model.meta: Small Business Committee · Rep. LaMonica McIver (D-NJ)

summary.text: The bill would direct the Small Business Administration's Veterans Business Development office to comply with reporting requirements that have been recommended by the Government Accountability Office, aiming to improve oversight and accountability in how the agency serves veteran-owned businesses.
